start.welcome: Hi {user}! I put together a celebration kit: one song, three spoken greetings and a lyric sheet — with the name pronounced properly.
name.prompt: Who is the kit for? Send the full name of the person you are celebrating.
name.empty: I did not catch a name. Please type it out.
name.too_long: That name is longer than {max} characters. Send a shorter form.
name.invalid_chars: That does not look like a name. Letters, spaces and hyphens only, please.
name.confirm: I will sing it as {name}. Is that right?
occasion.custom_prompt: Tell me the occasion in a few words.
note.prompt: Anything personal to weave in? A nickname, a hobby, a family joke. Or tap Skip.
note.skipped: No problem — I will keep it warm and general.
output_language.prompt: Which language should the song and the greetings be in?
lyrics.no_rounds_left: No rewrites left on this order — let us record this version.
progress.queued: You are in the queue. This takes a few minutes.
delivery.kit_ready: The kit for {name} is ready. Happy celebrating!
status.no_orders: You have not made a kit yet. Send a name to start.
payment.free_for_now: This one is on us — no payment needed right now.
error.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
error.service_unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Please try again a little later.
error.invalid_input: That did not work. Please check it and send it again.
error.content_not_allowed: I cannot make a kit with that content. Try different wording.
error.provider_generic: Our studio hiccuped. Please try again.
error.provider_slow: This is taking longer than usual. Please try again in a moment.
error.provider_busy: The studio is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
error.name_pronunciation_best_effort: I could not get the pronunciation perfect this time, so I sent my closest take.
error.delivery_failed: The kit is ready but I could not send it. Please try again.
error.payment_failed: The payment did not go through. Please try again.
error.unknown_command: I do not know that command. Send /start to begin.

error.too_many_orders_today.one: You can make {count} kit a day. Try again tomorrow.
error.too_many_orders_today.other: You can make {count} kits a day. Try again tomorrow.
